title: Prism Lab
objectives: Order the seven colours as VIBGYOR

stages.title: Rebuild the Colours
stages.narration: The crystal's colours are gone. Split white light to weave them back, Rainbow Weaver!

steps.text: The crystal is now colourless and grey.
Professor Prism raises a glass prism to the light.
Seven colours burst out across the wall!

stages.title: Bends Most vs Bends Least
stages.prompt: Sort these colours by how much a prism bends them.
stages.note: In VIBGYOR, violet bends most and red bends least — that is why they spread into a spectrum.

stages.title: Rainbow Recipe
stages.prompt: Is each thing NEEDED to see a rainbow?

tasks.label: Bright sunlight
tasks.explain: Sunlight is the white light that gets dispersed.

tasks.label: Water droplets in the air
tasks.explain: Each droplet acts as a tiny prism.

tasks.label: The Sun behind you
tasks.explain: You see a rainbow with the Sun behind and rain in front.

tasks.label: A glass prism in your hand
tasks.explain: The droplets are the prisms — you don't need a glass one for a sky rainbow.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Weave the Rainbow
stages.prompt: Score 80% to restore the crystal's colours and win shard 6!

questions.q: Splitting white light into its colours is called…
questions.explain: Dispersion spreads white light into VIBGYOR.
Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red.

questions.q: A spun Newton's disc of seven colours looks…
questions.explain: Combining the colours gives back white light.

questions.q: In a rainbow, each raindrop acts like a…
questions.explain: Droplets disperse sunlight into colours, like tiny prisms.

questions.q: The outer edge of a rainbow is…
questions.explain: Red is on the outside, violet on the inside.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 6 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Rainbow Weaver badge
Colour floods back into the crystal — it's glowing again!
